purpose: Retrospective audit specification, not a new scientific trial or a change to prior selection rules.

rounds.gate_interpretation: All four fixed arms evaluated. Three Kingdoms original unavailable cells remain alongside the valid supplement. Control_path passes only the eight-endpoint development screen; broader variants fail. No default promotion.

Fresh control and cap400 OrthoBench/Three Kingdoms; QfO fresh-control failure retained and matched cached control separately admitted. Cap400 QfO graph/native/scoring recoveries are not uninterrupted fresh timing. Four tracked primary F1 endpoints decline; reject promotion.

Candidate-specific inferred phylogeny across eight endpoints, with incompatible historical OrthoBench control and overly long QfO scoring namespace failures preserved before scoped recovery. Both control and candidate native universes verified. OrthoBench/GO declines fail the unchanged screen.

Large-only and medium-only deferral separate the mechanisms. The large branch is inactive on the two 12-species datasets; exact native reuse is not validation of active branch accuracy. All three noncontrol complete vectors fail the screen.

Bounded strong components, unchanged 1.5 edge threshold and 500-gene cap, own inferred phylogeny. Narrow-panel inactivity and QfO native/scoring recovery preserved. Reference F1 gains trade against GO decline beyond the original tolerance; no fresh whole-pipeline promotion trial warranted.

Matched accepted-hit multiset, filename-based species-pair block ordering, unchanged within-block rows. Exact arrival controls and all endpoint changes retained. Canonical collection changes memberships as well as reproducibility; point-screen pass is not biological equivalence or default promotion.

Exact ties across distinct anchor groups deferred at both attachment stages. OrthoBench decline 0.004471105890636373 passes the pre-existing 0.005 follow-up gate; QfO/Three Kingdoms then evaluated with the same scientific source. Complete-vector point-screen pass is small mixed development evidence, not promotion.

Fresh min1/cap100 HMM search against matched cached canonical min4/cap100 controls, unchanged downstream settings and original CPU libraries. QfO original duplicate-export failure preserved beside lossless derived export and scoring recovery. All four primary F1 endpoints decline. Reject promotion; functional population changes are not annotation improvement.

Fresh direction equivalence and complete-proteome OrthoBench pilot passed validity, but strictly positive F1 and P/R decline constraints failed. No QfO/Three Kingdoms extension, no retuning. Seven missing endpoints implement the stopping rule, not unfinished authorized runs.

limitations: This specification records the original rules and interpreted outcomes, not proof that its assertions are true; the readback must verify its claims and retain unknowns.
Precommit ancestry and frozen source identity do not prove historical execution, simultaneous resource isolation or biological generalization.
Recoveries and inactive-policy reuse require their own evidence; do not equate identical F1 with input identity.
No experiment or default change is authorized by this retrospective audit.
